name: Northwest Pipeline Capacity Replacement Project
researcher_notes: Expansion row under parent P0230 (Northwest Gas Pipeline); no existing row for this project among 529 US gas rows. FERC draft EIS notice (Federal Register 7 Mar 2005, docket CP05-32) states 79.5 miles of new 36-inch pipe in 4 loops (Whatcom to Thurston counties), 10,760 hp new compression, up to 360 thousand dekatherms per day, abandonment of the 26-inch line Sumas to Washougal. EIA Aug 2026 workbook, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 422: Completed, in service 2006, 80 mi, 333 million dollars, 360 MMcf/d, docket CP05-32. Both pass url_verifier; FR notice read for the values, EIA verified for project name only. Length staged as 79.5 mi from the FR notice (EIA rounds to 80). Capacity is 360 Mdth/d in the FR unit; EIA lists 360 MMcf/d as the same figure. Two sources are the same underlying FERC record, so not counted as independent. Status completed in 2006 so operating; the FR notice states the planned finish and the EIA row states completion. Owner spelled as in the notice; the owner style tool found no legal-form match, so check the entity name (Northwest Pipeline LLC today, Williams subsidiary). Start/end places are the corridor ends of the abandoned 26-in line, not confirmed for the new loops, which sit in 4 loops across Whatcom to Thurston counties. Route: no route sourced yet; check FERC final EIS GIS or Washington UTC. Cost 333 million from EIA only.
